Synapse — Streaming + WASM Agent + A2A Architecture (v0.2) ​

Status: Draft v0.2 — supersedes v0.1 (2026-06-30) after scope pivot on 2026-07-01 (each Agent is its own WASM module, full use of a2a-rs SDK, Synapse as foundation layer for Prefrontal and other downstream "supervisor" projects).

Status: Implementation in progress on branch feat/streaming-a2a. See 2026-07-01-v0.2-status.md for what's actually shipped, what's deferred, and what needs decisions before tagging v0.2.

0. v0.2 pivot — what changed ​

v0.1 (2026-06-30)v0.2 (2026-07-01)
End-to-end streaming in single processEach Agent = one independent WASM module
A2A client/server in-process; SDK optionalA2A must fully use a2a-rs SDK
LLM config baked into model structLLM config (base URL, API key, model) injected from host
Agent is server OR clientEach Agent has both inbound (consumed via A2A Server) and outbound (consumed via A2A Client) capability
—Synapse is foundation layer; Prefrontal is one downstream supervisor
—MSRV bump 1.75 → 1.85 (a2a-rs requirement)

1. Project positioning (recap of project-boundary doc) ​

Synapse = foundation library (layer 2). Prefrontal, and any future supervisor / cluster project (layer 3+). shadow-* apps (layer 4).

Within Synapse we do:

  • Streaming primitives (StreamReader, AgentStreamEvent)
  • LLM provider abstractions (OpenAI / Anthropic over wasi::http and reqwest)
  • A2A protocol wrappers around a2a-rs SDK
  • WASM agent package format & runtime plumbing (wasmtime-based)

We do not do scheduling, supervision, persistence, axum serving, auth, or UI.

2. System overview ​

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Downstream supervisor (Prefrontal, etc.)                    │
│                                                              │
│  axum HTTP server ─ a2a-rs server ─ a2a-rs client            │
│                       │                │                     │
│                       ▼                ▼                     │
│             ┌──────────────────────────────────┐             │
│             │  Synapse WASM Runtime            │             │
│             │   ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐    │             │
│             │   │ agent-1  │  │ agent-2  │    │             │
│             │   │ .wasm    │  │ .wasm    │    │             │
│             │   └──────────┘  └──────────┘    │             │
│             └──────────────────┬──────────────┘             │
│                                │ wasi::http                  │
│                                ▼                             │
│                          LLM provider endpoints               │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Each agent WASM module exposes a fixed contract — the WASM Agent ABI — that the supervisor invokes to route inbound A2A calls and consume streaming events.

3. WASM Agent ABI ​

Full reference: docs/wasm-agent-abi.md. Summary below.

3.1 Imports (host → WASM) ​

Synapse assumes the host provides:

  • wasi:http/outgoing-handler — for outbound HTTP / SSE to LLM providers
  • A custom synapse:host/agent-config with one export function get_config(ptr, len) -> (ptr, len) returning a JSON blob with: llm_base_url, llm_api_key, llm_model, a2a_peers[]
  • A custom synapse:host/a2a-call with send_to_peer(peer_id, msg_ptr, msg_len, out_ptr, out_len_ptr) for outbound A2A peer calls (since a2a-rs client SDK is native-only; the host executes the call and returns the response)

3.2 Exports (WASM → host) ​

A Synapse-compiled agent MUST export:

SymbolTypePurpose
agent_card(out_ptr: i32) -> i32 (writes AgentCard JSON, returns length)A2A discovery
stream_run(input_ptr: i32, input_len: i32, out_handle_ptr: i32) -> i32Yield a stream handle for inbound message/send or message/stream calls
cancel_run(handle: i32) -> i32Cancel a running stream by handle
query_task(task_id_ptr, task_id_len, out_ptr) -> i32Return current task state for tasks/get
subscribe_task(task_id_ptr, task_id_len, out_handle_ptr) -> i32Subscribe to task events (server push / resubscribe semantics)

Streaming via shared linear memory: agent writes AgentStreamEvent records into a host-provided ring buffer; host polls the buffer when reading the agent's outbound stream response.

3.3 Memory model ​

  • WASM owns linear memory.
  • Exports take (ptr, len) for input strings and a pointer where the agent may write responses.
  • Host pre-allocates one buffer (default 64 KiB) per stream handle for outbound AgentStreamEvent payloads.
  • ABI version stamp: each WASM image exports a synapse_abi_version function returning a u32; current target is 1.

4. A2A integration ​

4.1 Server side ​

  • a2a-rs v0.4 (a2a-server-lf) provides DefaultRequestHandler + AgentExecutor (a 2-method trait).
  • Synapse provides SynapseAgentExecutor that implements AgentExecutor and bridges events to whatever WASM-side execution model the supervisor decides (typically: instantiate a runtime, look up the WASM module by ID, invoke its stream_run export).

4.2 Client side ​

  • a2a-rs v0.2 (a2a-client-lf) provides A2AClient<T: Transport> with A2AClientFactory for protocol negotiation.
  • Important: client SDK only has native transport. Synapse wraps client usage at the supervisor boundary — within WASM, peer calls go through the synapse:host/a2a-call import (defined in 3.1) which the supervisor fulfills via the native A2AClient.

4.3 v1 capabilities (full use of a2a-rs as user requested) ​

CapabilityStatus
message/send (JSON-RPC)✅
message/stream (JSON-RPC + SSE)✅
tasks/get, tasks/list, tasks/cancel✅
tasks/subscribe (with resubscribe)✅
tasks/pushConfig CRUD✅ (opt-in)
agent-card.json discovery✅
Extended agent card❌ deferred
gRPC / SLIMRPC bindings❌ not in deps

5. LLM provider streaming ​

5.1 Native (host side) ​

  • HttpClientSse::sse_post via ReqwestHttpClient::execute_raw — already implemented (chunk 2/3 done).

5.2 WASM (inside agent WASM) ​

  • WasiHttpClient (already in Synapse) needs an SSE extension — NEW work needed: WasiHttpClient::sse_post using wasi:http/types stream chunks and the same shared SSE parser.

5.3 MessageDelta and AgentStreamEvent (already implemented) ​

The streaming core is platform-agnostic; Chunks 1+2+3+4 of v0.1 remain valid in v0.2.

6. Configuration injection ​

To honor "support 传入 LLM API 地址等信息" (externalized config):

  • Each agent WASM at startup calls host::get_config(...).
  • The host supplies:
    • llm_base_url — e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1
    • llm_api_key — runtime secret, never baked into WASM
    • llm_model — e.g. gpt-4o
    • llm_extra — provider-specific overrides (org ID, project, etc.)
    • a2a_peers — list of (name, url) for outbound peer discovery
  • Synapse provides a synapse-agent-config JSON schema + serde impl so the configuration round-trips cleanly.

8. Out of scope for v0.2 ​

  • Persistent task stores (sqlite/postgres) — InMemoryTaskStore only.
  • Auth implementations (OAuth2/API-key) — CallInterceptor hook exposed.
  • WASM-side A2A client — peer calls go through host import.
  • Multi-region A2A — supervisor concern.

9. Migration from v0.1 ​

  • Existing docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-30-streaming-design.md remains a useful reference for Chunks 1–4 (Streaming core), but its §6 (Provider streaming), §7 (Agent streaming), §9 (A2A), §11 (Migration) sections are superseded by this v0.2 doc.
  • Chunks 1–4 landed (foundation). The MultiAgent supervisors (v0.1 Chunk 5) are superseded by the WASM-per-agent architecture; deletion is fine since they are reference patterns re-implemented by Prefrontal.
